schema: hn-integrations/0 (accepted D-045; D-047: hooks talk to the app over local HTTP)
paths: ~ = user home (%USERPROFILE% on Windows). Merge ops keep every entry that is not ours; ours = a hook whose command contains `marker`.
hub: Every hook POSTs the agent hook JSON to http://127.0.0.1:24816/v1/event/<agent>/<state>. The app writes the template files as they are (no path to fill in).

claude.name: Claude Code

preferred.note: `claude` may only exist inside the Claude desktop app (%APPDATA%/Claude/claude-code/<ver>/claude.exe); use that path when it is not on PATH.

fallback.note: Claude installs it on its next start. UNVERIFIED: WS-APP to confirm.

claude.manual: In Claude: + next to the prompt box > Plugins > Add marketplace `human-needed/plugins` > install humanneeded. Or in a terminal: claude plugin marketplace add human-needed/plugins, then claude plugin install humanneeded@humanneeded. New sessions light the puck.

codex.name: Codex

preferred.after: Codex runs plugin hooks only after the user trusts them: in Codex type /hooks (CLI) or open Settings > Hooks (app) and trust the HumanNeeded hooks. Cannot be automated (trust is per hook hash).
preferred.note: `codex` may only exist inside the Codex app (WindowsApps/OpenAI.Codex_*/app/resources/codex.exe on Windows); use that path when it is not on PATH.

fallback.after: Codex runs new hooks only after the user trusts them: tell the user to open Codex and approve them (CLI: /hooks; app: Settings > Hooks or the 'Review hooks' prompt). Can't be automated (trust is per hook hash).

codex.manual: In a terminal: codex plugin marketplace add human-needed/plugins, then codex plugin add humanneeded@humanneeded. Then in Codex trust the hooks: /hooks (CLI) or Settings > Hooks (app).
codex.restart_needed: new sessions; hooks must be trusted

installed_plugin.note: Installed as a Codex plugin (2.0.0+). Either this or the old hooks_json marker means installed. NEW: WS-APP2 to adopt.

cursor.name: Cursor

install.note: Create the file as {"version":1,"hooks":{}} when missing. Cursor reloads it on save.

cursor.manual: Add the entries of plugins/cursor/hooks.json (Windows: hooks.windows.json) from github.com/human-needed/plugins to ~/.cursor/hooks.json (create it with {"version": 1, "hooks": {}} if missing). Cursor picks it up at once.
